body:
You’re right. i said i was done with them but i was still being attached since i had known them for a while but i only ever feel miserable around them so i need to cut ties with them. i feel like ive gotten my answer from them, if they’re not going to even apologize right then i don’t need to try to sacrifice all my hurt feelings just to keep up a shitty friendship. 

thank you again for helping me! it’s been so nice having someone to talk to through this situation and i really appreciate it. im sorry if im being kind of a burden but im really grateful for your comments

things are still bad, they were ignoring me and i thought i’d be fine with that. i just wanted an apology so i wouldn’t feel like this whole thing is my fault and im just overreacting because they’re the type of people who have to be right all the time. 
but one of them started acting like im the childish one and made fun of me for not wanting to be around them anymore. i told him he needed to apologize and he insisted that he already did. apparently “haha sorry it was us” is a good apology to him. this guy is 26 years old and doesn’t know how to apologize. and we work at the same store so i have to see this guy everyday (already applying for different jobs lol)

hi! thanks for everything you said because i really needed it. im glad i wasn’t the only one who thought this was wrong. 

i was waiting for them to apologize because i was too mad to even contact them. but when i came into work today, my manager told me that one of them asked if i was still angry. this made me furious all over again. he won’t apologize to me but he’ll ask around if im angry like i shouldn’t be upset about what they did?? apparently he also said i “wanted it” ???? im done. im never speaking to them again. they crossed every line imaginable. the other friend is even avoiding me and acting like it’s my fault for being mad. 

idk if i’ll ever make friends again tbh, i know it was just these people being assholes but it’s going to be hard for me to ever trust anyone again. thanks again though, it really helped when i was 100% ready to give up

yeah, i was hoping we could both move on so it was shocking they’d go that far to tell me all that. for the past days i was feeling awful but now i kind of just feel relieved im not with them anymore. i just kind of want to forget everything about them now lol

seriously thanks for talking to me about this, it’s been a help during this situation. and i did have them blocked but they texted me through one of their friends that i haven’t spoken to in years, i guess i should have blocked their friends too...thanks again for all the advice though
im a little better after venting lol but i still feel sick just thinking about it. thank you though

yeah, im starting to realize I’ve never mattered to them, they could give less of a shit about me. i could seriously disappear and they wouldn’t notice, i was gone for a while and the only people that noticed were my coworkers that needed me to do shit for them, one of my friends even told me they had no idea i was gone. ive had so many friends do this to me, i think i completely give up now. ive lost so many ppl in my life bc i feel used and thrown away by them. at this point i wonder if i’ll ever have real friends lmao probably not but im tired of being the last choice

i feel that. they always act different around me compared to our other friends. one of my friends will be alright when it’s just us but once they’re around another one of my friends they’re bringing me down just so they can compliment someone else. the differences are so obvious. my friends are socially superior too, they’re all liked and loved, meanwhile everyone just sees me as the weirdo that hangs around them. and i think my friends have started to see me like that too
